eligible_persons: Zimbabwean citizens/permanent residents returning after 2+ years abroad
conditions: One motor vehicle per family, owned/used for 12+ months prior to return, imported within specified window
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations, SI 257 of 2003 (as amended)
notes: Duty-free import limited to one vehicle; VAT may still apply in some cases

eligible_persons: Persons certified as physically handicapped by a medical practitioner
conditions: Vehicle must be adapted or suited to the disability; suspension of Customs Duty and Surtax only (not VAT); 5-year disposal restriction
legal_reference: Customs and Excise Act [Chapter 23:02], Suspension Regulations
notes: Application made directly to the ZIMRA Commissioner

eligible_persons: Accredited diplomats and staff of designated international organisations
conditions: Goods for official or personal use within accredited diplomatic quota
notes: Administered via Ministry of Foreign Affairs clearance letter

eligible_persons: Holders of a valid ZIDA investment licence
conditions: Capital equipment imported for an approved investment project within the approval period
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations - Capital Equipment

eligible_persons: Registered Private Voluntary Organisations (PVOs) and approved NGOs
conditions: Goods donated for humanitarian relief, not for resale; PVO registration certificate required
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations - Donated Goods
notes: Subject to ZIMRA verification of end use

exemption_name: Personal Effects and Household Goods on Relocation
eligible_persons: Persons taking up permanent residence in Zimbabwe
conditions: Used personal/household effects owned for 6+ months prior to importation, not for resale
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations - Personal Effects
notes: Excludes motor vehicles, which fall under separate rebate

conditions: Equipment used exclusively for primary agricultural production
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations - Agricultural Equipment
notes: Administered jointly with Ministry of Agriculture

exemption_name: Solar and Renewable Energy Equipment Incentive
conditions: Solar panels, batteries and related renewable energy equipment for own use or resale
notes: Duty-free; VAT treatment may vary by component

exemption_name: Medical Donations and Government Health Procurement
eligible_persons: MOHCC, registered hospitals, and approved health NGOs
conditions: Medicines and medical equipment for public health use, not for commercial resale
legal_reference: Customs and Excise (Rebate) Regulations - Medical Donations

exemption_name: Mission of Mercy / Disaster Relief Goods
conditions: Goods imported specifically for declared national disaster relief efforts
notes: Time-bound exemption tied to declared disaster period
